abstract_evidence_excerpt: Glycyl radical enzymes (GRE) use radical-based biochemistry to catalyze the cleavage or formation of the carbon-carbon and carbon-heteroatom bonds found in organic molecules. These evolutionarily ancient enzymes are highly oxygen-sensitive but widespread in obligate as well as facultative anaerobes.
